text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—A wish that has lived in my heart
ever since I was a little child.

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text: “...I want to be a princess.”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"A true princess must be! Splendid, elegant, and valiant!
Blazing Princess ☆ Princess Fighter!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text: "I want to become a strong, wonderful princess just like PreCure...!!"

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*... I can too become one...
Even I can be a princess...

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
No way in hell! As if someone like you
could ever become a princess!!

text_block_list.name: Girl in One-Piece Dress
text_block_list.text:
Kai-kun's right!
A crybaby failure like you could never become one!

text_block_list.name: Boy in T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-nyah! Crybaby whiner!
*Nobody* thinks you're ever gonna become a princess, so there!

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... No way...
No way...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I most certainly do not~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Siiilence, boys and girls over there!
Admiration is the ideal image of who you want to become.
Who has the right to deny someone pursuing that?!

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What the heck...?
Popping out of nowhere like that...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Don't go hitting or tackling me out of nowhere!
Laughing at someone's dream is just uncalled for...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD...! WHOOOOOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Boy in T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
Eep. The ground...
The ground is caving in... !?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For bad little girls tainted by evil hearts,
as a princess, I shall provide loving guidance...!!

text_block_list.name: Boys
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaah! A violent horse girl---!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heh... What a nostalgic phrase.
Rest assured, you are safe now, girl with the braids!

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Um,
thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't pay it any mind!
As a princess, it is only natural
to help someone in need!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
By the way... do you
wish to become a princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...There is no need to be so stiff and tense.
All those mean bullies have gone bye-bye now."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I'm just like you—
a fellow comrade who yearns to be a princess♪"

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text: ! B-Big sis, you too...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Kawakami Princess having
a cheerful chat with a young girl in the park.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "And then, PreFie overpowers Dark Princess with her mighty legs! Beating her to a pulp!!"

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text: Bachi-boko...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer!
Would you like to join our princess discussion too?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh, it is a ritual to speak passionately of the princess I strive to be and reaffirm my aspirations!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...And if you keep pushing forward true to yourself
without losing sight of your goals, one day, without fail,
you will meet someone who sees you for who you truly are.

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text: Without losing sight of my goals, staying true to myself...

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text: Bye-byeee~! Big sisss!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's meet again~!
choice_data_list: You two talked for quite a long time.
You really got deep into conversation, huh.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I just didn't want her to give up, so... before I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I was also once on the side
of being told that I "couldn't do it."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "...Long ago, before I entered the academy, I knocked on the doors of various prestigious clubs to train my legs."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Friend
text_block_list.text:
You're taking the entrance test for that club too, Kawakami-chan?
Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall become a trainee!
After all, that club is the prestigious, passionate club featured in episode 2 of "Flat♭Prefi"!

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure... third time's the charm.
No, fourth time's the success...!

text_block_list.name: Prestigious Club Coach
text_block_list.text:
"You don't match our club's colors.
Besides, looking at the state you're in—"

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
...*sniffle*. I... wasn't picked
again...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Hey. You want to become...
...a princess, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Then you don't even have to run.
A princess... must be a graceful, well-behaved girl."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "‘Your dreams and aspirations belong to you! No one has the right to decide them for you!’"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What I want to become. What I want to be is...

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"A true princess must be! Splendid, elegant, and valiant!
Blazing Princess ☆ Princess Fighter!!
Nothing can stop a dreaming heart!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You truly are a princess, desu wa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Even if they say it doesn't suit me, that it's out of reach, or that I'm not cut out for it! I still want to become the princess I envision!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I want to gain new power, just like PriFai!
Strong enough to win GⅠs and the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because I've decided to become the strongest princess,
one who won't lose no matter how scary the opponent is!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara she set as her goal is the collective name for three GⅠ races: the Oka Sho, Japanese Oaks, and Shuka Sho.
A challenge open only to the Classic class—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It is a dazzling, passionate stage truly befitting a princess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later on, I decided to arrange a mock race to help Kawakami Princess perform even better in actual competition.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Please watch me closely!
I'll do my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Declaring so, Kawakami Princess strode courageously toward the gates.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she can unleash her power, this race will surely be hers. Watching with high hopes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
U-Ugh……
My-My head……

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes. I only bumped my head on the gate the tiniest bit. I am perfectly fine...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Despite her claim, Kawakami Princess walked with an awkward limp. Rushing her to the infirmary—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—Everything looks completely normal.
You're in the picture of health.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "S-See, what did I tell you~?! It's completely fine~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm only running in one more race, so please—
Trainer, you are worrying far too much!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew... One, two!
One, two!! As soon as the gates open—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
M-My apologies...
The gates haven't opened yet, have they...
choice_data_list: ...Let's make sure to be careful, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I understand that, but...
The moment I think it's a race, my body just acts on its own...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inferring from the situation, it seems she got so overly excited about the "race" that her body isn't moving the way it normally should.
choice_data_list: (...I wonder if things will be okay from here on out.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, with a lingering sense of unease, I decided to think the matter over.
